description: The contract, criteria, data vintage and licence for the Treasury Curve History service (rates): the endpoint contract, the 14 tenors, the source line, the settled vintage text and the licence line. Read these before paying — every response is reproducible from the pinned public test corpus. — no payment required: call directly without payment (no x402 challenge; this tool is free). HTTP equivalent: GET https://exchangerebel.com/toll/rates/schema. Data vintage: a fixed historical snapshot of the Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates — business days 1990-01-02 through 2026-10-09, collected October 2026 from the official U.S. Department of the Treasury feed (fiscaldata.treasury.gov / home.treasury.gov), whose terms offer the data free, without restriction, for commercial redistribution. Dates after 2026-10-09 are not covered by this snapshot. Public test corpus: treasury-curve-history-corpus/v1, SHA-256 pin cbf25f7b8e109235ed7d00518b355fce6a5a7539ded5f42aeccd6721ce729d5c.
